const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['company_name','reporting_period','metrics'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const metrics=body.metrics;if(typeof metrics!=='object'||Array.isArray(metrics))return[{json:{valid:false,error:'metrics must be an object'}}];const sections=Array.isArray(body.sections)?body.sections:['executive_summary','financial_performance','growth_metrics','product_highlights','team_and_operations','risks_and_mitigations','outlook'];return[{json:{valid:true,companyName:body.company_name.trim(),reportingPeriod:body.reporting_period.trim(),preparedBy:body.prepared_by||'',preparedDate:body.prepared_date||new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],metrics,sections,narrativeContext:(body.narrative_context||'').slice(0,2000),keyHighlights:Array.isArray(body.key_highlights)?body.key_highlights:(body.key_highlights||'').split('
').map(h=>h.trim()).filter(Boolean),keyRisks:Array.isArray(body.key_risks)?body.key_risks:(body.key_risks||'').split('
').map(r=>r.trim()).filter(Boolean),outlook:(body.outlook||'').slice(0,600),askOfBoard:Array.isArray(body.ask_of_board)?body.ask_of_board:(body.ask_of_board||'').split('
').map(a=>a.trim()).filter(Boolean),currency:body.currency||'USD',replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You write board reports for startup and growth-stage companies. Good board reports: lead with what matters most, are honest about challenges (boards hate surprises later), give context for numbers not just the numbers, and have a clear ask. They're written for time-constrained board members who want signal not noise. Always respond in valid JSON only.
